population_description: Synthetic ship-design records supplied as the complete nltl:ship population of each input. External legal/application eligibility and the experimental source-edition selection are research assumptions, not facts inferred from RDF. This is not real-vessel certification. The population includes incomplete, inconsistent and unrecognized-value records; represented correctness is not assumed. Conditions inside the represented requirement, effective activation, missing represented inputs, paths, units, datatypes and query correctness remain for generated SHACL to address from supplied source/schema. The represented domain is Polar Code Introduction 2.1 design-condition/category records externally assumed within the selected safety-related Code research population. The supplied controlled design-condition value is a record of design intent, not independently measured ice-navigation capability. No particular category or design condition is assumed true for every record; source conditions and unavailable selector information remain generated-validation/review responsibilities.
